component.name: Mimebind
component.summary: Choose which application opens which file type

description.p: Mimebind lists every file type that an installed application knows how to open and lets you pick the application each one should use. It edits the standard XDG association files, so the choice applies on any desktop that follows the freedesktop.org specification, not only GNOME.

ul.li: Choose default apps for the web, mail, calendars, images, audio and video
Browse by installed application or by media type
Applications are credited with the subtypes the MIME database derives from the types they declare
Make one application the default for every file type it supports, or for one group of them, in one step
Search file types by name or by MIME type
See the current default application next to each type
Pick a new default from the applications that declare support for the type
Review everything you changed and reset any of it, or all of it
